news.title: Neighbors say dead dogs dumped in Atlanta neighborhood, raising health and safety concerns
news.summary: People living in a northwest Atlanta neighborhood say someone has been dumping dead dogs on their street and even in residents’ yards.

news.title: Armed suspects target Atlanta family at Turks and Caicos rental
news.summary: Seven masked men armed with guns, machetes, and sticks targeted an Atlanta family and their friends during a home invasion at a Turks and Caicos Airbnb over Labor Day weekend.

news.title: Sedan overturns multiple times in fatal Covington Highway crash
news.summary: A driver died Sunday afternoon following a multi-vehicle rollover crash at a DeKalb County intersection, according to police.

news.title: 2 metro Atlanta officers off the force after Flock Safety audit catches misconduct
news.summary: Two members of a metro Atlanta police force are now without jobs after a recent audit of how the department uses its Flock Safety technology.

news.title: Victim was 6 when abuse began; man convicted on all 18 counts in child abuse case
news.summary: A Cherokee County jury convicted a 64-year-old man of all 18 charges he faced involving sex crimes against a child, according to the Blue Ridge Judicial Circuit District Attorney’s Office.

news.title: 1 dead, 1 injured after crash off I-20 onto Windsor Street on-ramp
news.summary: One person is dead, and another is hospitalized after an SUV crashed off I-20 East near Windsor Street SW and landed on an on-ramp below early Sunday morning, according to the Atlanta Police Departmen
